findings.description: 64 stalled chunked POSTs reset the 65th connection here too. This build alone accepts an over-long size line: 17 digits (`00000000000000000b`) and a 31-digit line both return 200 with `CL 11`, where the other four answer 400 on the same input, so a size line of arbitrary length reaches the parser. It is also the only build that answers a clean 400 to bare-LF chunk framing (`:62`), where the other four stall instead. All 38 accepted shapes agree.
findings.title: Same slot stall and 65th-connection reset, and this is the one build with no 16-digit size cap

limitations: All RCE in this corpus is RCE on the upstream host
